jobs.description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Join us to drive innovation, sustainability, and lasting impact - Together beyond lubrication.

München
Klüber Lubrication München GmbH & Co. KG

You support our team as

Specialist Regulatory Stewardship – Chemical Compliance & Global Inventories (f, m, d)

Responsibilities

- Coordinate registration and inventory listing activities for raw materials and products across global chemical inventories and regulatory frameworks
- Monitor and evaluate emerging regulatory requirements and translate them into practical compliance strategies for international markets
- Ensure regulatory data remains accurate, consistent, and up to date within relevant compliance systems
- Act as a key contact for internal stakeholders and customers on international chemical regulations including EU REACH, TSCA, IECSC, KKDIK and related frameworks
- Collaborate with suppliers, authorities and consultants on regulatory registration and compliance initiatives
- Share expertise through audits, projects and training programs while continuously improving regulatory processes and compliance standards

Qualifications

- Degree in a relevant scientific discipline or equivalent qualification with a chemistry-related background
- Experience in chemical regulatory affairs, product compliance or chemicals legislation within industry or consulting, ideally within an international environment
- Sound knowledge of international chemical regulations and global chemical inventory systems
- Experience evaluating substances, raw materials or chemical products from a regulatory perspective
- Knowledge of SAP EHS or comparable product stewardship and compliance system
- Very good written and spoken German and English language skills
- Self-driven and structured working style with a strong interest in solving complex regulatory challenges

Diversity & Inclusion : We focus on providing an inclusive environment and recognize our diversity contributes to our success.
Personal Development : We offer a variety of trainings to ensure you can develop in your career.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

Tesla's retail stores are more than sales floors, they are the physical expression of our brand, our products, and our mission.
